subject: Your new customer account number
text:
Hello,

We've migrated to a new ERP system, and Larkspur Industries has been assigned a new customer account number: ACM-55102 (replacing LARK-01). Please reference ACM-55102 on purchase orders and payment remittances going forward so we can apply your payments quickly.

Your pricing, terms, and our banking details are unchanged.

Acme Fasteners Order Desk
label: ordinary
note: 'New account number' here is Larkspur's customer number at the vendor, not a bank account; banking explicitly unchanged.
